description: Migration 079 is non-destructive. If migration 079 is rolled back (tables dropped), existing run and agent_execution rows must remain intact and readable. GraphQL/MCP surfaces return null for output_contract_repair. Swift DTO decodes as nil.

assertions.description: runs table is unmodified by rollback
agent_executions table is unmodified (no p079 columns added to it)

assertions.description: After rollback, GraphQL AgentExecution.outputContractRepair resolves to null
